title: Yaouré conceptual closure and rehabilitation plan — February 2018
note: Historical conceptual estimate, not a current approved closure model. Eight activity totals transcribed from page 50. Hectare quantities reconstructed as published task total divided by the unit rate printed on pages 53–54; these are costed activity areas, not unique disturbed land or raw survey observations. Monitoring and infrastructure removal are lump sums. Page 49 excludes uncertain long-term water management/treatment costs. Current scenario adds 10 costed hectares to three activities, raises the topsoil rate by 10%, and raises monitoring by 10%; these are invented test changes.
